name: IPMAT Indore
full_name: IPM Aptitude Test (IPM AT), IIM Indore

cycle_2026.result: PI shortlist 25 May 2026; PIs mid-June 2026; offers late Jun 2026 (tentative per IIM Indore FAQ)

cycle_2027: Not announced yet (expected notification late Jan / early Feb 2027, exam around May 2027)
eligibility: Class XII passed in 2024 or 2025, or appearing in 2026; born on or after 1 Aug 2006 (1 Aug 2001 for SC/ST/PwD). IIM Indore sets no minimum % for its own IPM, but many other institutes using the score do.

pattern.marking: +4 / −1 for MCQs; short-answer +4, no negative. Max 360.
pattern.notes: Official procedure confirms 3 sections × 40 min and the marking. Question counts (15/30/45) are from coaching sources; IIM Indore's procedure PDF does not print them.

selection_process: Need positive raw score + category-wise minimum in all 3 sections → PI shortlist by Aptitude Test Score (ATS weights: QA MCQ 25, QA SA 25, VA 50) → Personal Interview (+ WAT) → final Composite Score = ATS 65% + PI 35%.
verbal_weight: 45 of 90 questions are Verbal Ability (VA is 50% of IIM Indore's shortlisting score)

colleges.name: IIM Indore
programmes: IPM (5-yr: BA Foundations of Management + MBA, dual degree; exit after 3 yrs with BA)
colleges.fees: ₹7.04 L (Yr 1), ₹6.54 L (Yr 2), ₹6.54 L (Yr 3) = ₹20.12 L for Yrs 1–3; Yrs 4–5 at PGP fee

cutoff.value: PI shortlist sectional minimums (Gen): QA-SA 28, QA-MCQ 27, VA 111. EWS 16/17/79; NC-OBC 16/14/70; SC 12/10/58; ST 8/8/49; PwD 4/3/30. 838 shortlisted for PI.
cutoff.note: Reported by Cracku and Career Launcher from IIM Indore's shortlist notice; not verified on iimidr.ac.in. 2025 Gen: QA-SA 24, QA-MCQ 28, VA 112.

colleges.selection: ATS 65% + PI 35%
colleges.placements: Class of 2024–26 final placements (MBA 492 + IPM dual-degree 94 combined): avg ₹27.27 L, median ₹25 L, highest ₹82.54 L

colleges.name: IIM Ranchi
programmes: IPM (5-yr: BBA + MBA; exit after 3 yrs with BBA)
colleges.fees: ~₹17.25 L for Yrs 1–3, excl. deposits/mess (unofficial, Hitbullseye); Yrs 4–5 at MBA fee

cutoff.note: IIM Ranchi has not published IPMAT cutoffs

colleges.selection: Separate application to IIM Ranchi. PI shortlist on IPMAT (VA 50%, QA 50%). Final: IPMAT 65% (VA 32.5 + QA 32.5) + PI 15% + Class X/XII 20% (X 8, XII 12); +5 bonus marks for female/transgender candidates.

colleges.name: IIM Shillong
programmes: IPM (5-yr integrated programme in management)

cutoff.note: Section-wise IPMAT cutoffs set by the Admissions Committee; not published

colleges.selection: Stricter eligibility: 70% in X and XII (65% SC/ST/DA) and Maths/Applied Maths in XI–XII. Applications 1–30 May 2026. Overall Score: Class X 10 + Class XII 10 + IPM AT 30 + PI 50. Overseas candidates may use SAT.

colleges.name: IIM Amritsar
programmes: IPM (5-yr dual degree, BS + MBA)

cutoff.note: IIM Amritsar does not publish IPMAT cutoffs

colleges.selection: Applications 23 Feb – 6 Apr 2026. Eligibility: age ≤ 20 on 1 Aug 2026; 60% in X and XII (55% SC/ST/PwD); Maths compulsory in XII. Composite: ATS 70% (QA-MCQ 30, QA-SA 30, VA 40) + PI 25% + gender diversity 5%.

colleges.name: IIM Sirmaur
programmes: BMS (4-yr Bachelor of Management Studies)
colleges.selection: Age ≤ 20 on 1 Aug 2026 (5-yr relaxation SC/ST/PwD); below 60% in X or XII is ineligible. Composite /100: IPMAT ATS 50 + online interview 20 + academics 25 (X 10, XII 15) + gender diversity 5.

colleges.name: IIM Sambalpur
programmes: BS in Management and Public Policy (4-yr, NEP exits after 1/2/3 yrs)
colleges.fees: Not published as an amount (semester-wise, incl. hostel and mess); application fee ₹2,000 + tax (Gen), ₹1,000 + tax (reserved)
colleges.selection: IPMAT 2026 is the only route (no CUET/SAT/JEE). 60% in X and XII (55% reserved); age ≤ 20 on 31 Jul 2026. IPMAT score + online PI. IIM Sambalpur's other UG programme (BS Data Science & AI) uses JEE Main; see the JEE entry.

programmes: IPM (5-yr: BBA Business Analytics + MBA International Business; exit after 3 yrs)
colleges.fees: ₹4 L/yr for Yrs 1–3; ₹19.68 L for Yrs 4–5; ~₹31.68 L total (Careers360, not verified on iift.ac.in)
colleges.selection: No interview reported. Merit /100: IPMAT score 77 + Class X 20 + gender diversity 3 (Careers360). 60% in X and XII (55% reserved); Maths at +2 required; apply by 20 Apr 2026; application fee ₹2,000 (₹1,000 SC/ST/PwD).

notes: Biggest IIM UG exam: one score is used by 6 IIMs (Indore, Ranchi, Shillong, Amritsar, Sirmaur, Sambalpur), IIFT and several private universities. Each institute needs its OWN separate application and uses its own weightage; some (Shillong, Amritsar, IIFT) need Maths in XII, and Shillong needs 70% in X/XII. Not the same exam as IPMAT Rohtak. NICMAR is also named by one coaching site but is not on IIM Indore's list.

name: IPMAT Rohtak

cycle_2026.result: PI shortlist 20 May 2026; PIs June 2026; final list July 2026

cycle_2027: Not announced yet (expected Feb 2027 notification, exam around May 2027)
eligibility: Class XII passed / appearing in 2026; 60% in X and XII (55% SC/ST/PwD) per Careers360; max age 20 as on 30 Jun 2026 (25 for SC/ST). Sources disagree on the % rule — check IIM Rohtak's notice.

pattern.notes: Most sources say 40 min per section; Careers360 says one shared 120-min window. Confirm on the admit card. IIM Rohtak's site could not be read directly.

selection_process: Single overall cutoff (no sectional cutoff) → PI shortlist → final merit: IPMAT 55% + Class XII 20% + PI 15% + Class X 10%.

colleges.name: IIM Rohtak
programmes: IPM (5-yr: BBA + MBA; exit after 3 yrs with BBA)
colleges.seats: 198 for 2026–31 (reported by Careers360/Hitbullseye; one source says 165)

cutoff.value: PI shortlist minimum total marks (/480): Gen 363, EWS 330, NC-OBC 307, SC 246, ST 168, DAP-Gen 260. ~1,030 shortlisted.
cutoff.note: Reported by iQuanta and Career Launcher. 2025 (Careers360): Gen 381, EWS 331, NC-OBC 297, SC 230, ST 138.

notes: Used only by IIM Rohtak. The same test (plus a Legal Reasoning section) is used for IIM Rohtak's Integrated Programme in Law, which is outside this site's scope. IIM Rohtak's website blocks automated reading, so all figures here come from news/coaching sites.

name: JIPMAT
full_name: Joint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test
conducted_by: National Testing Agency (NTA), for IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu

cycle_2026.application_window: 16 Apr – 13 May 2026 (extended from 10 May); correction 15–17 May

cycle_2027: Not announced yet (2026 notice came mid-April; expect a similar window)
eligibility: Class XII passed in 2024 or 2025, or appearing in 2026; 60% in X and XII (55% SC/ST/PwD); no upper age limit.

pattern.notes: No sectional time limit; one 150-min window. English only.

selection_process: No interview. IIM Jammu: must clear sectional percentiles (Gen 50, EWS/NC-OBC 35, SC 30, ST/PwD 25) → merit = JIPMAT percentile 70% + Class X 15% + Class XII 15%. IIM Bodh Gaya: sectional percentile floor → merit on JIPMAT score; offers in rolling lists after an Expression of Interest.
verbal_weight: 34 of 100 questions are Verbal Ability & RC

colleges.name: IIM Jammu
programmes: IPM (5-yr integrated programme in management)
colleges.fees: Not published here (offer acceptance ₹50,000, adjusted against Sem 1 fee)

cutoff.note: IIM Jammu publishes shortlisted application numbers, not a marks cutoff

colleges.selection: Merit: JIPMAT percentile 70 + Class X 15 + Class XII 15.

colleges.name: IIM Jammu – eBBA
programmes: eBBA (Hons) — 4-yr online BBA
colleges.selection: Accepts JIPMAT, JEE Main, CUET (General Test), SAT (min 700) or IIM Jammu's own eBBA test. Merit: test percentile 70 + X 15 + XII 15.

colleges.name: IIM Bodh Gaya
programmes: IPM (5-yr: BBA + MBA)
colleges.fees: Not published here (offer acceptance amount ₹60,000–₹90,000 reported)

cutoff.value: First-list JIPMAT score (/400): Gen 333+, EWS 310+, OBC-NCL 295+, SC 215+, ST 145+
cutoff.note: Manabadi report of 2025 first list; no official 2026 cutoff published.

colleges.selection: Merit on JIPMAT score; Class X/XII for eligibility and tie-breaks. Rolling offer lists after EoI registration.

notes: Only two IIMs use JIPMAT. No interview — the test score (plus board marks at Jammu) decides everything, so a candidate must apply separately on each IIM's portal after the result.

name: IIMK BMS AT

cycle_2026.result: Shortlist late May / early Jun 2026; interviews 3rd week of Jun 2026; classes Aug 2026
cycle_2026.fee: ₹4,250 (Gen); ₹2,125 (SC/ST/PwD) — reported by Cracku, not seen on IIMK site

cycle_2027: Not announced yet (2026 applications opened 20 Feb)
eligibility: Class XII (or diploma after Class X) from a recognised board, any stream; mark sheets by 1 Jun 2026 (provisional admission if XII completes by 31 Jul 2026).

pattern.notes: IIMK confirms two sections (Verbal, Quant), MCQ, computer-based; question counts, timing and marking are from coaching sources.

selection_process: Interview shortlist by Aggregate Index Score: test percentile 40% + Class XII 30% + Class X 30% → Personal Interview → final: test percentile 70% + PI 25% + gender diversity 5%.

colleges.name: IIM Kozhikode (Kochi campus)
programmes: BMS (Honours with Research) — 4-yr, with minors (Economics & Public Policy, AI/ML, Psychology, Finance, Liberal Studies)
colleges.fees: ₹7 L per year tuition + one-time ₹10,000 admission, ₹25,000 caution deposit; hostel/mess extra

cutoff.value: Interview-shortlist AIS cutoff (2025): Gen 86.975, EWS 70.267, NC-OBC 64.042, PwD 45.257, ST 36.798, SC 29.987

notes: 4-year programme (not a 5-year IPM). News reports say a JEE Main score of 80+ percentile (or SAT 1300+) can waive the aptitude test — not confirmed in IIMK's policy PDF, so check before relying on it.

name: IIMB UG Admissions Test
full_name: IIM Bangalore UG Admissions Test (BSc Hons)
conducted_by: IIM Bangalore (Dorabji Tata School of Undergraduate Studies)

cycle_2026.result: Interviews Jan 2026; offers by 28 Feb 2026 (~12,000 applied, 453 interviewed, 80 admitted)

cycle_2027: Announced: applications 17 Aug – 17 Oct 2026 (closed); test 15 Nov 2026 (tentative); interviews Jan 2027; offers 3rd week of Feb 2027
eligibility: Class XII with Mathematics in XI and XII; at least 60% in Class X Mathematics; age ≤ 20 on 1 Aug of the admission year.

pattern.marking: MCQ; 1/3 of the question's marks deducted for a wrong answer (reported as +3 / −1)
pattern.notes: Per IIMB FAQ. Careers360 reports sectional times of 30/60/30 min and a possible change to 135 min for the 2027 intake — unconfirmed.

selection_process: Test score → interview shortlist → final composite: test 60% + personal interview 40% (IIMB FAQ). Careers360 reports a more detailed split that also uses Class X marks — unconfirmed.

colleges.name: IIM Bangalore – Dorabji Tata School of Undergraduate Studies
programmes: BSc (Hons) Economics (minors: Data Science, Business Studies) — 4-yr
BSc (Hons) Data Science (minors: Economics, Business Studies) — 4-yr
colleges.fees: ₹8.5 L/yr for Yrs 1–2 (tuition, hostel, exams); mess extra (~₹8–10k/month); need-based scholarships

cutoff.note: IIMB has not published cutoffs; first batch began 2026

notes: Different calendar from other IIM UG tests: the test is held in Nov–Dec of Class XII, not in May. The 2027-intake test is on 15 Nov 2026 and applications have already closed.

name: IIMB DBE Entrance Test
full_name: IIM Bangalore BBA (Digital Business & Entrepreneurship) Entrance Test
cycle_2027: Not announced yet (2026 applications opened mid-April)
eligibility: Indian nationals; Maths compulsory in Class X; 60% in Class XII (55% SC/ST/PwD).

pattern.notes: IIMB's admission document does not give the test's sections, length or marking.

selection_process: Shortlist on the IIMB test, CUET (UG) General Test (Section III) or JEE Main score against category cutoffs. Previous-cycle Gen cutoffs: 50% (IIMB test), 70th percentile (CUET), 50th percentile (JEE Main).

colleges.name: IIM Bangalore – BBA DBE (online)
programmes: BBA in Digital Business & Entrepreneurship — 3-yr online (up to 6 yrs), exams at centres
colleges.fees: ₹4.5 L total (₹1.25 L + ₹1.5 L + ₹1.75 L); 50% waiver for SC/ST/PwD

cutoff.value: Previous-cycle Gen shortlist cutoff: 50% (IIMB test) / 70th percentile (CUET) / 50th percentile (JEE Main); NC-OBC & EWS 45%/65/45; SC/ST/PwD 40%/60/40
cutoff.note: Stated in IIMB's 2026–29 admission process document

notes: Online degree, not a residential campus programme. CUET or JEE Main scores can be used instead of IIMB's own test.
